input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, hold-harmless or defense provision anywhere: searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infringe" return no indemnity language, and the document moves directly from the mutual warranties in Section 9 (p0055–p0058) to General Provisions in Section 10 (p0059 onward). HDI therefore owes no indemnity for third-party IP claims arising from the Site or hosted services, nor for its own breach of law, breach of the confidentiality/customer-data obligations in Section 8, or gross negligence or willful misconduct — which is walk-away territory under the rule (no vendor IP indemnity at all). We have inserted a new Section 9A providing HDI's indemnity per the model language, with our reciprocal indemnity narrowed to the Content and Marks we supply and our own breach of law, plus standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 9A adding HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data/confidentiality breach, gross negligence/willful misconduct), a narrow reciprocal Company indemnity for Content and Marks it supplies, and standard indemnity procedure.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's indemnity for third-party IP claims relating to the Site and its own unlawful conduct, data/confidentiality breaches and gross negligence or willful misconduct, together with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately limited to the Content and Marks we supply and our own breach of law; if helpful, we can discuss usual IP exclusions and remedies (procure, modify, replace) instead.

ops.text: 9A. Indemnification. (a) HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Site, the services, software, tools, systems or other materials provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right (other than to the extent arising from Content or Marks provided by the Company); (ii) HDI's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Confidential Information or customer data caused by HDI; or (iv) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. (b) The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of an allegation that the Content or Marks provided by the Company infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right or out of the Company's breach of applicable law. (c) The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought; the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, provided that it shall not enter into any settlement that imposes any liability or obligation on, or requires any admission by, the indemnified Party without the indemnified Party's prior written consent; and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.
